# Gun Bar

> > Australia's premier firearm storage specialist offering secure storage, sales, and accessories services with integrity and transparency.

Gun Bar is an Australian-owned firearms retailer and secure storage facility based in Spring Hill, Queensland. The company specializes in firearm consignment sales, secure storage solutions, and a curated selection of firearms and accessories including brands like Fabarm and Pilla performance eyewear.
